name: discord_edit_channel_permissions
description: Set a permission overwrite for a role or member on a channel. Provide `channel_id`, `overwrite_id` (the role or member ID), `type` (0 role, 1 member), and `allow`/`deny` as permission bitfield strings (decimal). Requires MANAGE_ROLES.

overwrite_id.description: The role ID or member ID this overwrite applies to.

allow.description: Bitwise permission set to allow, as a decimal string (e.g. "1024").

deny.description: Bitwise permission set to deny, as a decimal string.
